I am an economist and Senior Researcher at [Red de Estudios para el Desarrollo (REDES)](https://www.redesarrollo.pe/), a Peruvian public policy think tank. I manage a team of research assistants and work on youth employment, urban poverty, inflation, food insecurity and public transport.

My work starts with data: microdata from national household, employment, education and energy surveys, analysed with impact evaluation methods (difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables) and data science tools in Stata, Python and R. I want that evidence to reach the public debate, which is why I write a regular column for *El Comercio* and present findings at universities across Peru.

## Experience

**Red de Estudios para el Desarrollo (REDES)** · Senior Researcher (since 2025), Researcher (2023-2024)

**Semana Económica** · Economic and Financial Analyst (2022-2023)

**GERENS Graduate School** · Junior Researcher and Consulting Assistant in energy regulation and competition, for clients including Peru’s Ministry of Economy and Finance, Ministry of Energy and Mines and Osinergmin (2020-2022)

**INDECOPI** · Intern, Technical Secretariat for Free Competition (2019-2020)

## Education

**Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP)** · BSc and Licentiate in Economics. Specialisation Diploma in Data Science for Social Sciences and Public Management.
